title: gentiana pumila subsp. delphinensis
intro: Gentiana pumila subsp. delphinensis, commonly known as Gentiana delphinensis, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Gentianaceae family. This plant is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia, and its name is derived from the Latin word 'gentia' meaning 'gentle', due to its delicate appearance. Gentiana delphinensis has been traditionally used to aid in digestion and as a treatment for various health issues, including fever and respiratory problems. Its bioactive constituents, which include gentianine and amarogentin, exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and are believed to contribute to its health benefits.
